I told Dana in their #north-team thread that the figure is 261 seats for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal.

- **Where it comes from:** the only place it appears is Ilse's post in #north-team on Oct 14. Dana is in that channel, so they could already see it. Nothing posted since then changes the number.
- **Not confirmed:** the files Dana can see don't include a renewal contract or order form to check it against. The March 2026 renewal digest only says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20, with no seat count. I suggested Dana check with Ilse or June if the tracker needs the signed number.
- **Older numbers:** the channel also has the earlier Amendment No. 1 figures from August 2025 (180, then corrected to 185). Those aren't the 2026 renewal count, so I left them out.

I didn't search conversations Dana can't see. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to post in the team channel.
